items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1994-01-15
items.q: He, he could have been a, he, he, he was a talent. He could, he could have, he could have happened, but he didn't.

ctx.x: Not, not the way we had expectations, but then, you know. The Five Royals. They were pretty good. The Sonics. Also not bad, yeah.
Ronnie Cold Trio. I don't know why we did that one. Yeah, did you, that one, you did another, you did another Ronnie Cold Trio record. Yeah, Ronnie Cold, Joe Hayward.
He, he could have been a, he, he, he was a talent. He could, he could have, he could have happened, but he didn't.
